title: Why do I have to brush twice?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Why do I have to brush twice?

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Once in the morning, once at night.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: But nothing happened to them today.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: That's the point — keep it that way.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Why do I have to use toothpaste?

variations: "brush twice" 换 "go to bed now"；"toothpaste" 换 "the foam one"。
